items.details: Engage lateral and longitudinal control with cruise control engagement. Note: Once lateral control is engaged via UEM, it will remain engaged until it is manually disabled via the MADS button or car shut off.

items.description: Choose how Automatic Lane Centering (ALC) behaves after the brake pedal is manually pressed in sunnypilot.

sections.title: Torque Control
sections.description: Steering torque tuning and lateral control method

items.title: Enforce Torque Lateral Control
items.description: Enable this to enforce sunnypilot to steer with Torque lateral control.

items.title: Lateral Jerk Torque Controller
items.description: Looks ahead at planned steering to reduce sudden corrections, so the wheel moves more smoothly through turns. Works with Self-Tune and custom tuning. Thanks to @twilsonco for the implementation.

items.title: Self-Tune
items.description: Enables self-tune for Torque lateral control for platforms that do not use Torque lateral control by default.

items.title: Less Restrict Settings for Self-Tune (Beta)
items.description: Less strict settings when using Self-Tune. This allows torqued to be more forgiving when learning values.

items.title: Enable Custom Tuning
items.description: Enables custom tuning for Torque lateral control. Modifying Lateral Acceleration Factor and Friction below will override the offline values indicated in the YAML files within "opendbc/car/torque_data". The values will also be used live when "Manual Real-Time Tuning" toggle is enabled.

items.title: Manual Real-Time Tuning
items.description: Enforces the torque lateral controller to use the fixed values instead of the learned values from Self-Tune. Enabling this toggle overrides Self-Tune values.

items.title: Torque Control Tune Version
items.description: Select the version of Torque Control Tune to use.

sections.title: Lane Change
sections.description: Automatic lane change timing and behavior

items.title: Auto Lane Change by Blinker
items.description: Set a timer to delay the auto lane change when the blinker is used. Default is Nudge.
items.details: Set a timer to delay the auto lane change operation when the blinker is used. No nudge on the steering wheel is required to auto lane change if a timer is set. Default is Nudge. Please use caution when using this feature. Only use the blinker when traffic and road conditions permit.

items.title: Block Lane Change: Road Edge Detection
items.description: Blocks lane change when the model sees a road edge on the side you signal.

items.title: Auto Lane Change: Delay with Blind Spot
items.description: Add a delay timer for lane changes when BSM detects a vehicle in your blind spot.
items.details: Toggle to enable a delay timer for lane changes when blind spot monitoring (BSM) detects a vehicle in your blind spot.

sections.title: nrdr Lateral Tuning
sections.description: Lateral tuning specific to the nrdr fork.

items.title: Handcrafted Lateral Tuning
items.description: Off by default. Enable this to load the Clarity-derived, road-tested lateral controller profile and lock the controls that profile owns.
items.details: Loads the shared versioned Honda PID/feedforward profile with predictive stiction, controller helpers, steering filters, and fixed live delay. Steer ratio is intentionally independent; choose its source in Steer Ratio Tuning. Leave this off to tune the controller values manually.

items.title: Run Tune Report Scan
items.description: Flip ON to scan every drive log into a tune report (the device flips it back OFF on the next start).

items.title: Loaded Profile
items.details: Live vehicle, controller, base-tune, geometry, and tuning-knob details are written here by the device.

items.title: Learn Tire Stiffness (Auto)
items.description: When ON (Auto), uses the live-learned tire stiffness factor. When OFF, uses the static base value of 1.0.

items.title: Learn Angle Offset (Auto)
items.description: When ON (Auto), uses the live-learned steering angle offset; OFF uses a static 0.0 offset.
items.details: When ON (Auto), uses the live-learned steering angle offset. When OFF, uses a static 0.0 offset. Turn OFF if a bad learned offset is pulling the car to one side.

items.title: Interpolated Torque/PIF Blend
items.description: Blend angle-feedback P/I/F with the generic f13 legacy torque controller.
items.details: The final request is Torque share times the f13de17 generic torque controller plus the remaining share times today's complete P/I/F controller. Torque uses angle feedback through 2 m/s, transitions from angle to calibrated yaw over 2-5 m/s, and uses calibrated yaw at 5 m/s and above. If required yaw is invalid, stale, missing, or non-finite, Torque does not reuse angle or update its controller state; the final request temporarily returns to 100% P/I/F. This generic yaw branch was not historically road-proven on Honda. All four settings are frozen while engaged, and Clarity NNLC is bypassed and reset.

sub_items.title: Torque / P/I/F Share
sub_items.description: Splits the final steering request between both complete controllers. Torque X% / P/I/F (100-X)%; default is 50% / 50%.
sub_items.details: The two shares always add to 100%. Changes are accepted only while disengaged and take effect on the next engagement.

sub_items.title: Spoofed Lateral Acceleration Factor
sub_items.description: Sets how much lateral acceleration the legacy torque half treats as full normalized steering torque.
sub_items.details: Higher values ask the torque half for less steering for the same planned curve. It scales Torque feedback error and non-friction feedforward, but never direct friction. This is m/s², not m/s. Changes apply on the next engagement.

sub_items.title: Torque-Side Friction Compensation
sub_items.description: Adds direct normalized steering torque to help the legacy torque half overcome rack friction.
sub_items.details: This value is independent of the lateral acceleration factor. Large values can make the torque half hit its limit quickly. Changes apply on the next engagement.

items.title: StarPilot PID Additions
items.description: Adds the borrowed StarPilot turn-in / unwind / per-direction output scaling, not built for Honda.
items.details: The borrowed turn-in / unwind / per-direction output scaling (the StarPilot half of _pid_output_scale) not built for Honda. Off = clean banded PID/F + rate-damping D, your center boost kept. Turn on to A/B it against the raw base.

items.title: Low Speed Proportional Scale (Below 25mph)
items.description: Scales the proportional (P) term below 25 mph.
items.details: Scales the proportional (P) term below 25 mph. Higher = more error correction (tighter, can cut corners); lower = looser with wider swings.

items.title: Low Speed Integral Scale (Below 25mph)
items.description: Scales the integral (I) term below 25 mph.
items.details: Scales the integral (I) term below 25 mph. Builds correction over time to erase steady-state error; too high oscillates.

items.title: Low Speed Feedforward Scale (Below 25mph)
items.description: Scales the feedforward (kf) term below 25 mph (100% = tuned value).
items.details: Scales the feedforward (kf) term below 25 mph. Follows the commanded angle rather than error, adding authority without amplifying noise. 100% = tuned value (static).

items.title: Standard Speed Proportional Scale (25-50mph)
items.description: Scales the proportional (P) term between 25 and 50 mph.

items.title: Standard Speed Integral Scale (25-50mph)
items.description: Scales the integral (I) term between 25 and 50 mph.

items.title: Standard Speed Feedforward Scale (25-50mph)
items.description: Scales the feedforward (kf) term between 25 and 50 mph (100% = tuned value).

items.title: Highway Proportional Scale (50mph+)
items.description: Scales the proportional (P) term above 50 mph.

items.title: Highway Integral Scale (50mph+)
items.description: Scales the integral (I) term above 50 mph.

items.title: Highway Feedforward Scale (50mph+)
items.description: Scales the feedforward (kf) term above 50 mph (100% = tuned value).

items.title: Rate Damping (D) Strength
items.description: Adds a damping (D) term opposing wheel speed to flatten low-speed oscillation; 0 = off.
items.details: The derivative term openpilot normally can't use. Adds torque opposing how fast the wheel is moving, which damps the low-speed oscillation plain P can't (the wheel is torque-commanded, so P alone rings). Relies on a clean steering-rate signal and a low-lag EPS - which this car has. 0 = off. Raise until the low-speed wobble flattens; too high makes turn-in feel heavy.

items.title: Rate Damping Fade-Out Speed
items.description: Speed at which rate damping tapers to zero (strongest at a standstill).
items.details: Speed at which rate damping tapers to zero. Damping is strongest at a standstill and gone by this speed, where tire self-aligning torque resumes damping the steering itself. Keeps the D term out of your highway feel.

items.title: Center Boost
items.description: Extra proportional (P) error correction near center; 0.50 is a 50% P boost.
items.details: Multiplies only the proportional term near center. Integral, feedforward, and damping keep their normal values. Available at every speed above the minimum, including the highway.

items.title: Center Boost Threshold (deg)
items.description: How centered should the steering wheel be when center boost is actually active?

items.title: Center Boost Minimum Speed
items.description: Below this speed center boost is disabled; there is no upper-speed cutoff.
items.details: Below this speed center boost is disabled. Above the short ramp it remains fully available, including on the highway.

items.title: Predictive Lateral Stiction
items.description: Tapers torque before a stable steering target, then holds it until another correction is needed.
items.details: PID remains the normal throw. A predictive capture stage can only reduce torque as the wheel closes on a stable target, then freezes the captured output until error, relative motion, drift, or a decisive corrective torque reversal requires reacquisition. It operates at every speed and immediately bypasses for driver input, lane changes, steering faults, or control limits. Default is OFF.

items.title: Enable Neural Network Lateral Model (NNLC)
items.description: Use PID at lower speeds and during lane changes, then smoothly hand off to the Clarity neural lateral model at higher speeds. Default is OFF.
items.details: OFF keeps the exact Clarity interface.py PID tune active everywhere. ON runs the PID/NNLC hybrid; lane changes immediately select PID before their opening torque command. NNLC remains configured but is inactive whenever a recognized Clarity is using the experimental firmware EPS position map or Interpolated Torque/PIF Blend.

sub_items.title: Activate NNLC Above
sub_items.description: Center speed of the smooth 6 mph PID-to-NNLC handoff. Default is 30 mph (PID full through 27 mph, NNLC full from 33 mph).

sub_items.title: NNLC KP Gain Scale
sub_items.description: NNLC proportional feedback gain. 100% gives kp = 1.0.

sub_items.title: NNLC KF Gain Scale
sub_items.description: NNLC neural-model feedforward gain. 50% gives kf = 0.5.

sub_items.title: NNLC KI Gain Scale
sub_items.description: NNLC integral feedback gain. 10% gives ki = 0.1.

items.title: Steer Ratio Mode
items.description: Choose exactly one geometry source. Manual is the same as turning all three in-car switches off.
items.details: Comma uses its last valid learned ratio as one number and holds it through brief message dropouts. NRDR uses the fixed audited Clarity angle-log curve, including a bilateral near-lock anchor at 435.7 degrees; it no longer holds the 247.5-degree point through the rest of the rack. Firmware uses an exact recognized EPS shape anchored to the car's stock center ratio. If an exact NRDR, firmware, or manual source is unavailable, the device safely uses the stock car ratio and reports that fallback.

items.title: Manual Override On-Center Ratio
items.description: Ratio used with the wheel straight ahead. A bigger number asks for more steering-wheel movement for the same planned curve; a smaller number asks for less. Default 15.38.

items.title: Manual Override Final Ratio
items.description: Ratio used near the end of wheel travel. Default 10.93.
items.details: NRDR blends smoothly from the on-center number to this final number using hidden car-specific outer-angle metadata. Cars without exact metadata keep their stock ratio instead.

items.title: Increase Driver Override Hysteresis
items.description: Reduces false driver override detections on sensitive Honda EPS by doubling the override threshold below.
items.details: Reduces the likelihood of false driver override detections (resulting in dropped torque) on sensitive Honda EPS platforms by doubling the override threshold below.

items.title: Driver Override Threshold
items.description: Raw steering torque reading above which you count as steering (override); default 1400.
items.details: Raw steering torque sensor reading above which you are considered to be steering (driver override). On cars with a different stock threshold, this value is applied proportionally so 1200 still represents the stock threshold.

items.title: Override Threshold Center Boost
items.description: Lower override threshold used within the Center Boost band; set equal to Driver Override Threshold to disable.
items.details: When the wheel is within the Center Boost degree band (on a straight), this lower override threshold applies instead of the one above - so you can override easily on straights while curves keep the higher threshold and do not drop torque from a false override. Set equal to Driver Override Threshold to disable.

items.title: Pass-through assist torque on override
items.description: Resets the EPS lane-assist state so the final override feels like normal driving after fade completes.
items.details: When enabled, openpilot resets the EPS internal state which determines whether it is in lane assist mode or not. As such, enabling this will make the final override feel exactly the same as normal driving (after fade is completed), and when disabled the steering rack may carry on a more resistive feeling.

items.title: Override Torque Fade Down
items.description: Controls how quickly steering torque fades out when driver override begins.

items.title: Override Torque Fade Up
items.description: Controls how quickly steering torque fades back in after driver override ends.

items.title: Override Torque Retain
items.description: Controls how much openpilot steering torque remains when the override has gone past Override Torque Fade Down.

items.title: Low Pass Filter (tau)
items.description: Smooths steering response at the cost of adding lag; tune to the least amount before oscillation.
items.details: Filter that smooths steering response at the cost of adding lag. Tune to the least amount possible before oscillations begin. Live tests show that going above 0.1 tau rapidly increases the possibility of lag-induced oscillations.

items.title: Low Pass Filter Tau (Below 25mph)
items.description: Low-pass filter time constant (seconds) below 25 mph.

items.title: Standard Tau (25-50mph)
items.description: Low-pass filter time constant (seconds) between 25 and 50 mph.

items.title: Highway Tau (50mph+)
items.description: Low-pass filter time constant (seconds) at or above 50 mph.

items.title: Legacy Steer Delta Rate Limiter
items.description: Limits how quickly requested steering torque can rise or fall.
items.details: Limits how quickly requested steering torque can rise or fall. This is an older system of limiting and may no longer prove useful compared to the low pass filter.

items.title: Steer Delta Up
items.description: Maximum upward steering torque rate when the rate limiter is enabled (too low will add lag).

items.title: Steer Delta Down
items.description: Maximum downward steering torque rate when the rate limiter is enabled (too low will add lag).

sections.title: nrdr Special
sections.description: Dashboard, diagnostics, and special features.

items.title: Injection Test (Caution!)
items.description: Multiplies the lateral PID output scale by 999% as a diagnostic stress test. Use with extreme caution.
items.details: When enabled, the lateral PID output scale is multiplied by 999%. This is a diagnostic stress test to see how the car reacts to a massive steering command. Use with extreme caution on a safe, empty road.

items.title: Alternative Dashboard Speed Design
items.description: Repurposes the cluster's set-speed slot to show lead, GPS, or true cluster speed (needs openpilot longitudinal).
items.details: Lead Speed shows the lead's speed in whole mph ("Stopped" below 1 mph, "--" with no lead). GPS Speed shows the comma's own true speed. Cluster Speed shows exactly what the dash cluster reads.

items.title: Alternative Dashboard Distance Design
items.description: Repurposes the cluster's distance bars / mini car (requires openpilot longitudinal).
items.details: Repurposes the cluster's distance bars / mini car (requires openpilot longitudinal). Radar closes the bars in as the lead approaches. Velocity pushes the bars out under acceleration and pulls them in under braking. Non-stock designs stay on the cluster permanently, even when not engaged.

items.title: Clear Dashboard Fault Codes
items.description: Forces the cluster's FCM/icon fault bits off and suppresses the stock FCW chime.
items.details: Forces the cluster's FCM/icon fault bits off and suppresses the stock FCW chime. Lets a car with a dead or absent stock camera run a clean dash. Turn OFF for stock openpilot behavior (camera values passed through, FCW chime active).

items.title: Spoof Camera Messages
items.description: Dead camera only - keeps the CAMERA_MESSAGES broadcast alive so the cluster never raises a high-beam fault.
items.details: Dead camera only - keeps the camera's CAMERA_MESSAGES broadcast alive so the cluster never raises "Auto High Beam System Problem" (that fault is a message timeout, not a code). Leave OFF if your stock camera works.

items.title: Cruise Button Sub-Mode
items.description: Dynamic HUD - the distance or set/resume button first wakes a blinking preview on the cluster.
items.details: Dynamic HUD - pressing the distance button or set/resume first wakes a preview on the cluster (current personality on the bars, set speed if engaged, all blinking). Only presses made during the preview actually change the personality or set speed. The blink starts lazy and accelerates continuously until it cuts off.

items.title: Sub-Mode Visibility Time
items.description: How long the preview stays on the cluster after a button press.
items.details: How long the preview stays on the cluster after a button press. The blink ramp always spans the whole window, slow at the start and rapid right before it falls off.

panels.description: Longitudinal control, speed limits, and cruise behavior

items.title: Dynamic Experimental Control
items.description: Let the model decide when to use sunnypilot ACC or sunnypilot End to End Longitudinal.

items.title: Disengage Cruise on Accelerator Pedal
items.description: When enabled, pressing the accelerator pedal will disengage longitudinal control.

items.title: Driving Personality
items.description: Standard is recommended; sets how closely sunnypilot follows lead cars and how it uses the gas and brake.
items.details: Standard is recommended. In aggressive mode, sunnypilot will follow lead cars closer and be more aggressive with the gas and brake. In relaxed mode sunnypilot will stay further away from lead cars. In econ mode sunnypilot keeps the longest following distance for smooth, efficient driving. On supported cars, you can cycle through these personalities with your steering wheel distance button.

sections.title: nrdr Longitudinal Tuning
sections.description: Longitudinal tuning specific to the nrdr fork.

items.title: Live Learning Gas
items.description: Allows Honda gas and wind compensation factors to learn live while driving.
items.details: Fresh installs default OFF when a gas pedal interceptor is detected and ON otherwise. Your selection is preserved afterward. While ON, all longitudinal PID personality scales are held at 100%.

items.title: Keep Feedforward Static
items.description: When ON, the active personality PID scale multiplies only the feedback (P+I) terms; feedforward (kf) stays tuned.
items.details: When ON, the active personality PID scale multiplies only the feedback (P+I) terms; the feedforward (kf) keeps its tuned value instead of being scaled along with it. The lateral PID scales have their own toggle.

items.title: Honda Nidec: ECU-matched longitudinal improvements
items.description: Honda Nidec only. Shapes the longitudinal command to match the factory ECU; OFF = stock command path.
items.details: Honda Nidec only. Shapes the longitudinal command to match the factory ECU - rate-limits the acceleration command to the ECU's ramp rates, applies a speed-dependent coasting deadband (wide at low speed, tight on the highway), and briefly coasts through gas/brake transitions to avoid lurch. Calibrated on the 2019 Pilot; other Nidec cars may need tuning. OFF = stock command path.

items.title: Full Nidec Brake Authority
items.description: Allows supported Honda Nidec longitudinal control to use the full normalized brake-command range.
items.details: Enabled by default. Disable to retain the upstream brake-command headroom. This setting operates independently of Live Learning Gas.

items.title: Roen Nidec Acceleration Limits
items.description: Uses Roen's ISO-based planner and Nidec pedal-controller acceleration envelopes with full low-speed pedal scaling.
items.details: Enabled by default. Applies only to Honda Nidec cars with a gas interceptor. The planner allows 4.0 m/s² through 5 m/s, fading to 2.0 m/s² at 20 m/s; the controller fades from 4.0 to 3.0 m/s², while ordinary low-lateral-acceleration driving retains the full envelope. This operates independently of Live Learning Gas.

items.title: Honda Bosch-A Radar (experimental)
items.description: Decodes the factory radar on supported Honda Bosch-A vehicles with stock longitudinal or openpilot Alpha Long.
items.details: EXPERIMENTAL — The reverse-engineered object format has not been road-validated on every supported model. Disable this setting if radar tracks look incorrect. With Alpha Long, these tracks feed openpilot's lead tracking and longitudinal commands; factory Honda AEB/CMBS remains unavailable.

items.title: Honda Dashboard Variant B
items.description: Turn ON if your cluster is Variant B (4 dashed lane lines). Placeholder for now - has no effect yet.
items.details: Honda clusters round the cruise set-speed (km/h to mph) two different ways. Variant A (3 dashed lane lines drawn, the default) and Variant B (4 dashed lane lines) round differently, so the same speed reads e.g. 60 on A vs 61 on B. Turn ON if your cluster is Variant B. Placeholder for now - has no effect until the rounding correction is built.

items.title: Distance 1 / Aggressive PID Scale
items.description: Scales the longitudinal PID controller for the Aggressive personality (distance setting 1).
items.details: Defaults to 200%. Effective only with a gas pedal interceptor and Live Learning Gas OFF; otherwise longitudinal PID scaling is fixed at 100%.

items.title: Distance 2 / Standard PID Scale
items.description: Scales the longitudinal PID controller for the Standard personality (distance setting 2).
items.details: Defaults to 100%. Effective only with a gas pedal interceptor and Live Learning Gas OFF; otherwise longitudinal PID scaling is fixed at 100%.

items.title: Distance 3 / Relaxed PID Scale
items.description: Scales the longitudinal PID controller for the Relaxed personality (distance setting 3).
items.details: Defaults to 80%. Effective only with a gas pedal interceptor and Live Learning Gas OFF; otherwise longitudinal PID scaling is fixed at 100%.

items.title: Distance 4 / Econ PID Scale
items.description: Scales the longitudinal PID controller for the Econ personality (distance setting 4).
items.details: Defaults to 50%. Effective only with a gas pedal interceptor and Live Learning Gas OFF; otherwise longitudinal PID scaling is fixed at 100%.

items.title: Set-Speed Overshoot Allowance
items.description: Allows the cruise target to follow vehicle speed by up to this amount above the set speed when no other speed target is lower.
items.details: 0 mph preserves stock behavior.

items.title: Cruise Mismatch Correction
items.description: Correct slight variances in final cruising target speed to better match the current and set speeds.
items.details: Correct slight variances in final cruising target speed to better match the current and set speeds together. Tire, suspension, and other vehicle dynamics can affect this including manufacturer design. If your car permanently drives at 71mph set at 70mph, lower this until correct on a flat road, or vice versa for the opposite problem.

items.title: Stopping Decel Rate
items.description: Brake-rate limiter used while coming to a stop (carcontroller).

items.title: Stop Accel
items.description: Target acceleration once stopped (holds the brake).

items.title: Planner Stopping Rate
items.description: How quickly commanded deceleration ramps down while coming to a stop.

items.title: vEgo Stopping
items.description: Speed (m/s) below which the planner treats the car as stopping.

items.title: vEgo Starting
items.description: Speed (m/s) above which the car is considered moving again.

items.title: Green Traffic Light Alert (Beta)
items.description: A chime and on-screen alert play when the light you are waiting for turns green with no vehicle ahead.
items.details: A chime and on-screen alert will play when the traffic light you are waiting for turns green and you have no vehicle in front of you. On-screen visual alert is only available on comma 3X. Note: This chime is only designed as a notification. It is the driver's responsibility to observe their environment and make decisions accordingly.

items.title: Lead Departure Alert (Beta)
items.description: A chime and on-screen alert play when you are stopped and the vehicle in front of you starts moving.
items.details: A chime and on-screen alert will play when you are stopped, and the vehicle in front of you start moving. On-screen visual alert is only available on comma 3X. Note: This chime is only designed as a notification. It is the driver's responsibility to observe their environment and make decisions accordingly.

items.title: Tesla Rainbow Mode
items.description: Display a rainbow effect on the path the model wants to take (it does not affect driving in any way).

items.title: Enable sunnypilot
items.description: Use sunnypilot for adaptive cruise control and lane keep driver assistance.
items.details: Use the sunnypilot system for adaptive cruise control and lane keep driver assistance. Your attention is required at all times to use this feature.

items.title: Enable Lane Departure Warnings
items.description: Receive alerts to steer back when you drift over a lane line without a turn signal above 31 mph (50 km/h).
items.details: Receive alerts to steer back into the lane when your vehicle drifts over a detected lane line without a turn signal activated while driving over 31 mph (50 km/h).

items.title: Always-On Driver Monitoring
items.description: Enable driver monitoring even when sunnypilot is not engaged.

sections.title: General
sections.description: Power, boot, and unit preferences

items.title: Wake Up Behavior
items.description: Controls the state of the device after boot or sleep.
items.details: Controls state of the device after boot/sleep. Default: Device will boot/wake-up normally and will be ready to engage. Offroad: Device will be in Always Offroad mode after boot/wake-up.

items.title: Prevent Automatic Shutdown
items.description: Prevents openpilot's automatic offroad shutdowns after the vehicle is turned off.
items.details: When enabled, this bypasses the Max Time Offroad timer and its low-voltage and estimated-battery safeguards, and can drain the vehicle battery. When disabled, those safeguards resume after a 60-second grace period. Manual Power Off still works.

items.title: Max Time Offroad
items.description: Sets the automatic shutdown timer after the vehicle is turned off.
items.details: This applies only when Prevent Automatic Shutdown is disabled; battery safeguards may shut the device down sooner. The default is 30 hours.

sections.title: Updates
sections.description: Control software updates

items.title: Disable Updates
items.description: When enabled, software updates will be off (requires a reboot to take effect).

sections.title: nrdr Force Update
sections.description: Trigger a remote device update.

items.title: Force Update
items.description: Flip ON to run the full updater chain (check, download, install, reboot). Only works while the car is off.
items.details: Flip ON to run the full updater chain on the device (check, download, install, reboot). The device flips this back OFF when it picks up the request - that is your acknowledgment. Only works while the car is off. Watch Remote Action Status below for progress.

sections.title: Connectivity

items.title: Enable ADB
items.description: ADB (Android Debug Bridge) allows connecting to your device over USB or over the network.
items.details: ADB (Android Debug Bridge) allows connecting to your device over USB or over the network. See https://docs.comma.ai/how-to/connect-to-comma for more info.

items.title: sunnypilot Longitudinal Control (Alpha)
items.description: WARNING: alpha longitudinal control for this car disables Automatic Emergency Braking (AEB).
items.details: WARNING: sunnypilot longitudinal control is in alpha for this car and will disable Automatic Emergency Braking (AEB). On this car, sunnypilot defaults to the car's built-in ACC instead of sunnypilot's longitudinal control. Enable this to switch to sunnypilot longitudinal control. Enabling Experimental mode is recommended when enabling sunnypilot longitudinal control alpha. Changing this setting will restart sunnypilot if the car is powered on.

sections.title: Test Maneuvers
sections.description: DANGER: enabling these maneuvers replaces normal driving behavior with deterministic test sequences. Each toggle requires explicit confirmation per write. Use only in a closed environment.

items.title: [TEST] Lateral Maneuver Mode
items.description: Replaces normal lateral control with a deterministic test sequence. NOT for road use.

items.title: [TEST] Longitudinal Maneuver Mode
items.description: Replaces normal longitudinal control with a deterministic test sequence. NOT for road use.

items.title: Show Advanced Controls
items.description: Toggle visibility of advanced sunnypilot controls.
items.details: Toggle visibility of advanced sunnypilot controls. This only changes the visibility of the toggles; it does not change the actual enabled/disabled state.

items.title: GitHub Runner Service
items.description: Enables or disables the GitHub runner service.

items.title: copyparty Service
items.description: copyparty is a capable file server for downloading routes, viewing logs, and editing some files from your browser.
items.details: copyparty is a very capable file server, you can use it to download your routes, view your logs and even make some edits on some files from your browser. Requires you to connect to your comma locally via its IP address.

sections.title: StarPilot Lane Centering (SPLC)
sections.description: Experimental confidence-gated lane centering ported from StarPilot. Biases the model command toward the detected lane center while remaining subject to normal curvature and jerk limits.

items.title: SPLC (StarPilot Lane Centering)
items.description: Experimentally bias the model command toward the detected lane center. Requires two confident lane lines and remains subject to normal curvature and jerk limits.

items.title: SPLC Pause on Turn Signal
items.description: Fade the lane-centering correction out when a turn signal is active so it does not fight a lane change or turn.

items.title: SPLC Center Offset
items.description: Shift the lane-centering target left or right of the lane center. The controller automatically reduces the offset when the detected lane is narrow.

items.title: SPLC E2E Override
items.description: How strongly a confident end-to-end model path can override lane centering when it deliberately departs the lane center. 1.0 gives the model full authority; 0.0 disables break-in.

sections.title: Model Behavior
sections.description: Lane desire and lead-vehicle awareness tuning

items.title: Use Lane Turn Desires
items.description: At 20 mph (32 km/h) or below with your blinker on, the car plans a turn that way at the nearest drivable path.
items.details: If you are driving at 20 mph (32 km/h) or below and have your blinker on, the car will plan a turn in that direction at the nearest drivable path. This prevents situations (like at red lights) where the car might plan the wrong turn direction.

items.title: Adjust Lane Turn Speed
items.description: Set the maximum speed for lane turn desires.

items.title: Live Learning Steer Delay
items.description: Allow device to learn and adapt car's steering response time

items.title: Adjust Software Delay
items.description: Add software delay on top of the vehicle's actuator delay when Live Learning Steer Delay is off.
items.details: This additional delay is combined with the vehicle's actuator delay. The default additional value is 0.2 seconds. Higher values increase prediction lead and may cause early or oscillatory steering.

sections.title: Lateral Control
sections.description: Neural network lateral control for supported models

items.title: Neural Network Lateral Control (NNLC)
items.description: Use a neural network for lateral control instead of the default torque controller.

items.title: Adjust Camera Offset
items.description: Virtually shift camera's perspective to move model's center to Left(+ values) or Right (- values)

items.title: Honda Nidec: Enforce Factory Longitudinal Control
items.description: sunnypilot will not take over control of gas and brakes. Factory Honda Nidec longitudinal control will be used.

items.title: Stop and Go for Manual Parking Brake (Beta)
MADS Screen Activation
items.description: Use a multi-finger press on the infotainment screen to toggle MADS. This allows the use of full MADS functionality when enabled. Selecting a higher finger count may reduce accidental activations. Note: Setting this to Off will reset your MADS settings to default.

items.title: Enforce Factory Longitudinal Control
items.description: sunnypilot will not take over gas and brakes; factory Toyota longitudinal control will be used.

items.title: Stop and Go Hack (Alpha)
items.description: Allows some Toyota/Lexus cars to auto resume during stop and go traffic. Alpha feature - use at your own risk.
items.details: sunnypilot will allow some Toyota/Lexus cars to auto resume during stop and go traffic. This feature is only applicable to certain models that are able to use longitudinal control. This is an alpha feature. Use at your own risk.
